author: fidjissimo
text: None of this would have been possible without the early days determination and grit of our founders - @apoorva_mehta, @Max and @shiftb. Thank you for the creative spark that founded Instacart and for entrusting me to lead the company’s next chapter.

author: fidjissimo
text: So excited to be taking Instacart public today! The last two years have been a wild ride, but I’m really proud of the business this team has built, turning us into an enduring and profitable company that delivers a critical service to millions of people. https://t.co/2qKDWqeGji
